title: Currencies, Value Chains, and Air Pollution: How Value Chain Position and Exchange Rates Shape Industrial Emissions
Do Energy Audit Mandates Change Buildings? Evidence from New York City
abstract: Energy audit mandates seek to improve investment by requiring owners to identify efficiency opportunities. We study New York City's Local Law 87, which mandates audits, retro-commissioning, and reporting for large buildings while leaving most broader capital improvements to owners. Using a regression-adjusted local-projection difference-indifferences design that exploits predetermined filing deadlines, we find recorded filing rises by 47.8 percentage points, while permit activity, energy use, and emissions change little. Area-weighted estimates rule out reductions larger than 1.1 percent in energy use and 0.5 percent in emissions. Mandatory diagnosis can generate a strong administrative response without comparably large near-term physical adjustment.
abstract_zh: 能源审计强制性规定旨在通过要求业主识别能效机会，来改善投资。我们研究了纽约市的第87号地方法（Local Law 87），该法规定大型建筑必须进行审计、再调试（retro-commissioning）并提交报告，同时将大多数更广泛的资本改善留给业主自行决定。我们采用经回归调整的局部投影双重差分设计，利用预先确定的提交截止日期，发现记录在案的提交比例上升了47.8个百分点，而许可活动、能源使用和排放的变化则很小。以面积加权的估计排除了能源使用降幅超过1.1%、排放降幅超过0.5%的可能性。强制性诊断可以产生强烈的行政响应，但不会在近期产生同样大幅度的实体调整。

title: Do Foreign Tariffs Reshape Domestic Land Use?
abstract: How do external policy shocks reshape local resource use when multiple activities compete for a shared factor? We study foreign tariffs and U.S. agricultural land use from 2005 to 2023 using county-level harvested acreage as a measure of realized land use. Fixed 2000-2004 export and crop shares map crop-specific tariff changes into county exposure, allowing us to separate crop reallocation from changes in total acreage. Higher tariff exposure shifts land toward exposed crops, while the scale response depends sharply on which crops carry the exposure. Because this response changes a county-wide acreage base, exposure concentrated in one crop can generate acreage changes elsewhere in the local portfolio. Relative to the 2004 tariff schedule, observed 2023 acreage is 29.9 million acres higher, with scale incidence concentrated in high-acreage, corn-oriented counties and the largest crop-level movements in corn and soybeans. Removing the tariffs remaining in 2023 yields a 22.9-million-acre difference under predominantly non-corn exposure, shifting scale incidence toward specialized non-corn counties while corn and soybeans retain substantial scale components. Across both tariff environments, changes in the acreage base are quantitatively first-order, implying substantial physical land-use incidence that crop reallocation alone misses.
abstract_zh: 当多种活动竞争同一生产要素时，外部政策冲击如何重塑地方资源利用？我们以2005至2023年美国农业用地为研究对象，考察外国关税的影响，以各县收获面积作为实际土地利用的衡量指标。以2000至2004年固定的出口和作物份额，将特定作物的关税变化映射为各县的暴露程度，从而将作物间的再配置与总面积的变化区分开来。较高的关税暴露会使土地转向受暴露的作物，而规模效应则在很大程度上取决于哪些作物承受了暴露。由于这一反应改变了全县的面积基础，集中于单一作物的暴露可能会在当地种植结构的其他部分产生面积变化。与2004年的关税表相比，2023年观测到的面积高出2990万英亩，其中规模效应的归宿集中于高面积、以玉米为主的县，而作物层面最大的变动出现在玉米和大豆上。若取消2023年仍然存在的关税，在以非玉米作物为主的暴露情形下，面积差异为2290万英亩，规模效应的归宿转向以非玉米作物为专业化生产的县，而玉米和大豆仍保有相当大的规模效应。在两种关税环境下，耕地面积基础的变化在数量上都居于首要地位，这意味着存在大量的实体土地利用归宿效应，而仅考察作物再配置会遗漏这些效应。

title: Can the Federal Reserve Save the Environment?
abstract: This paper studies the effect of monetary policy on environmental quality via the channel of global value chains (GVCs). From a proxy-VAR analysis with U.S. monetary policy surprise as an external instrument, we show that a contractionary monetary policy which escalates domestic credit costs and induces stronger local currency has a causal effect of reducing emissions, but more importantly, raising emission intensities due to firms’ discouraged participation to GVCs which, in turn, entails reduction in pollution offshoring. This result indicates that monetary policies primarily aiming for economic stabilization have unrecognized environmental externality.
abstract_zh: 本文研究货币政策通过全球价值链（GVC）渠道对环境质量的影响。以美国货币政策意外冲击作为外部工具，我们利用代理向量自回归（proxy-VAR）分析表明，紧缩性货币政策会提高国内信贷成本并使本币走强，它对减少排放具有因果效应；更重要的是，它会因企业参与全球价值链的积极性受到抑制而提高排放强度，进而减少污染的离岸转移。这一结果表明，主要以经济稳定为目标的货币政策具有未被认识到的环境外部性。
